subject.title: fix(oauth): recover refreshable_bearer refresh failures like plain OAuth

question: Should this PR land with terminal refreshable_bearer refresh failures clearing matching cached token or credential state?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it intentionally changes OAuth bearer cache recovery semantics and can require re-authentication or token reseeding for terminal provider errors.

options.title: Accept the recovery behavior
options.body: Merge after ordinary maintainer review because the PR prevents poisoned refresh-token replay and has focused tests plus runtime logs.

options.title: Require serialization first
options.body: Hold the PR until per-entry refresh serialization eliminates the remaining one-call concurrent-loser failure mode.

options.title: Choose different cache semantics
options.body: Decline or narrow the cache-clearing behavior and leave the linked issue open for a different recovery design.

recommendation.title: Accept the recovery behavior
recommendation.body: Merge after ordinary maintainer review because the PR prevents poisoned refresh-token replay and has focused tests plus runtime logs.
